exposure: patient comfort with home monitoring skills (weight, blood pressure, fetal heart tones)
outcome: patient preferences for prenatal visit number
patient preferences for between-visit contact with care team
patient preferences for alternative care models (individual care, pregnancy medical homes, home visits)
patient preferences for postpartum visit number and timing of first visit
cohort: The study included 300 postpartum women admitted for childbirth and recovery at an academic institution.
finding: Current prenatal and postpartum care delivery models do not align with patients' preferences for visit number or between-visit contact, and patients are receptive to alternative care models including remote monitoring.
cross-section timing: Postpartum, during admission for childbirth and recovery
